macros.name: import
macros.doc: Two new LaTeX commands, "\import {<full-path>} {<file>}" and "\subimport {<path-extension>} {<file>}" are defined to input a file from another directory, allowing that file to find its own inputs (using \input, \includegraphics etc.) in that directory.

macros.name: subimport
macros.doc: The \subimport command facilitates nesting of file imports. It takes a relative 〈path-extension〉 based on the location of the current imported file.
